# DQP — Diverging Questions Protocol

> Experimental deterministic questionnaire compiler and runtime. Software 0.1.1; source format DQP 1.0.

- [JSON Schema](schemas/dqp-1.0.schema.json): Structural validation; compiler checks additional invariants.
